summary.text: Michael Potter is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
An environmental consultant, he also ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Michael Potter graduated from Center Grove High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University in 1999, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as environmental consultant.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Johnson County for 30 of his 50 years and has had a 23-year career as a licensed professional geologist and environmental science consultant.
Potter was the Democratic candidate for Indiana House District 47 in the November 5, 2024 general election, which incumbent Robb Greene won with 74.0% of the vote to Potter's 26.0%.
In the 2024 survey, he named environment, education and healthcare as the policy areas he is passionate about.
